title: Add cursor follow animation
context: Add a subtle cursor-follow visual effect to increase perceived polish while preserving performance and accessibility.

tasks.title: Implement and mount cursor follower component
acceptance_criteria: A dedicated CursorFollower component renders a decorative follower element
Follower position updates on pointer movement using transform-based animation
Follower is disabled for coarse pointers and reduced-motion users
Follower does not block interactions (pointer-events: none and appropriate z-index)
App integrates CursorFollower without affecting existing sections
Focused unit tests cover rendering and pointer movement behavior
npx vitest run src/components/__tests__/CursorFollower.spec.ts src/__tests__/App.spec.ts, npm run type-check, and npm run build-only all pass
